description: This file contains unit tests for the class DittoMessageSubjectValueValidator, primarily testing validation logic for message subject headers within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: DittoMessageSubjectValueValidatorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for unit testing DittoMessageSubjectValueValidator's validation logic regarding message header subjects.

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Initializes static valid message subject string before all tests run.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Creates an instance of DittoMessageSubjectValueValidator before each test.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullDefinition
methods.description: Tests that passing null as header definition throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullValue
methods.description: Tests that accepting null as the message subject value throws a DittoHeaderInvalidException.

methods.name: canValidateDittoMessageSubject
methods.description: Checks that the validator reports it can validate String type.

methods.name: acceptValidCharSequence
methods.description: Ensures that a valid message subject string does not throw an exception upon acceptance.

methods.name: doesNotValidateAsDefinedJavaTypeIsNotDittoMessageSubject
methods.description: Verifies that the validator does not incorrectly validate non-message subject types.

methods.name: acceptNonDittoMessageSubjectString
methods.description: Tests that invalid message subject strings trigger validation exception.
